summary: Firefox made substantial improvements to **video frame handling and measurement**: the browser now properly constrains video rectangles to image buffer boundaries, validates frame dimensions during encoding, resets picture regions when decoder output size changes, and correctly tracks video sample counts and frame rates across stream changes. Separately, audio infrastructure was enhanced with telemetry tracking for Audio Session API adoption and thread-safe access to audio drivers; live-stream media is now treated as controllable regardless of reported duration.
